Simulate many Skat games

Source: R/simulate.R
sk_simulate.Rd

Runs a Monte Carlo experiment: deals n random games, plays each out with the supplied players and game type, and returns a tidy table of outcomes. Use it to estimate win rates, average scores, and the distribution of declarer card points for a given strategy configuration.

Usage

sk_simulate(
  n = 100,
  game_type = "grand",
  declarer = 1,
  players = NULL,
  seed = NULL,
  verbose = TRUE,
  call = rlang::caller_env()
)

Arguments

n

Number of games to simulate. Defaults to 100.

game_type

A single game-type string, one of sk_game_types(). Defaults to "grand".

declarer

Integer in 1:3: the declaring seat. Defaults to 1.

players

A length-3 list of sk_player objects. Defaults to heuristic players for all seats.

seed

Optional whole-number seed for reproducibility. Defaults to NULL, which leaves the random state alone. When supplied, the previous random state is restored on exit.

verbose

Logical; show a progress bar. Defaults to TRUE.

call

The calling environment, used for error reporting.

Value

A tibble::tibble() with one row per simulated game and columns: game (integer index), game_type (character), declarer (integer), declarer_points (integer card points credited to the declarer, trick points plus skat), won (logical), schneider (logical), schwarz (logical), game_value (integer), and score (integer). Always a tibble with these nine columns and these types.

See also

sk_plot_points() and sk_plot_winrate() visualise the result.

Examples

sim <- sk_simulate(n = 20, game_type = "grand", seed = 1, verbose = FALSE)
mean(sim$won)
#> [1] 0.35
head(sim, 3)
#> # A tibble: 3 × 9
#>    game game_type declarer declarer_points won   schneider schwarz game_value
#>   <int> <chr>        <int>           <int> <lgl> <lgl>     <lgl>        <int>
#> 1     1 grand            1              87 TRUE  FALSE     FALSE           48
#> 2     2 grand            1              34 FALSE FALSE     FALSE           96
#> 3     3 grand            1              82 TRUE  FALSE     FALSE           72
#> # ℹ 1 more variable: score <int>
